name: 152 Club Bar & Grill
description: 152 Club is a welcoming karaoke bar known for its friendly atmosphere and diverse crowd. It offers a lively environment with a good sound system, ample screens for watching sports, and a variety of song choices. The venue features outdoor volleyball courts and a fenced-in area, making it a fun spot for both singing and socializing. The staff is praised for their friendliness and attentive service, creating a fun, inclusive space for all ages to enjoy karaoke, food, and drinks in a relaxed setting.
